criteria.original_criterion: The Language Reference states the Haskell/Qleisli boundary explicitly.
criteria.checked_contract: Explicit normative current-boundary classification under #80 ordinary decision and authority hierarchy.
criteria.limits: No new constitutional interpretation or general abstraction feature.

criteria.original_criterion: Static/program-description values and live quantum owners are clearly separated.
criteria.checked_contract: Static description fields/access are separate from runtime values; recursive quantum linearity includes tuple-contained zero-width owners.
criteria.limits: Description reuse is not owner duplication or separability.

criteria.original_criterion: Higher-order abstraction over static operations has a defined typing/lowering story.
criteria.checked_contract: Exact current Op formal/interface, explicit static arguments, access transfer, pending Meaning and concrete finite/native lowering are specified and tested.
criteria.limits: General arrows/builders and selected constructor convergence stay pending in their own Issues.

criteria.original_criterion: Unrestricted closure capture cannot duplicate or hide live quantum ownership.
criteria.checked_contract: No reusable callable/closure type; runtime and spent local categories cannot become callees or static providers; actual negative controls run before an absent checker.
criteria.limits: No universal closure-capture theorem or unsupported syntax checker claim.

criteria.original_criterion: Classical pattern matching, structural quantum destructuring and physical observation are semantically distinct.
criteria.checked_contract: Ordinary Bit conditions/patterns, explicit quantum structural maps/coherent lifting and explicit observation have distinct checked contracts.
criteria.limits: General ADT match implementation remains separate; selected runtime-if emitter is still unsupported.

criteria.original_criterion: Classical ADTs do not silently define coherent quantum sum semantics.
criteria.checked_contract: Current TypeKind/grammar has no general classical ADT/coherent-sum admission; Reference constrains later admissions without inheriting quantum sum semantics.
criteria.limits: This does not complete #64 or add either type family.

criteria.original_criterion: `Unit` / `Q<Unit>` / zero-width ownership behavior is documented consistently with exact semantics.
criteria.checked_contract: Exact Unit/owner distinctions, argument/body execution, scalar action and controlled/reference unit-map controls are specified and checked.
criteria.limits: Finite/selected quantum-Unit profile limits and broader source/runtime proofs remain.

criteria.original_criterion: Trait/type-class-like semantic capabilities identify where verifier evidence is required.
criteria.checked_contract: Current Apply/Adjoint/Controlled requirements are separate from concrete native-checked paths and exact Meaning evidence; wrong effects/access/meaning reject.
criteria.limits: General trait/class declarations and semantic laws are not implemented by this unit.

criteria.original_criterion: The verified Core does not depend on laziness, `bottom`, or unrestricted general recursion.
criteria.checked_contract: Eager calls and complete body checking; guarded natural arithmetic, checked decreasing self-call, zero-fold and cycle controls. Explicit finite proposals reach independent checking.
criteria.limits: No general compiler termination/source-preservation/quantitativeRS theorem; scoped bodies and checked Nat recursion remain permitted.

criteria.original_criterion: Currying/partial application cannot create reusable closures over hidden live quantum owners.
criteria.checked_contract: Complete call arity and lexical local-callee/provider refusals prevent partial calls from producing reusable hidden-owner callables.
criteria.limits: General currying/function values remain unsupported; no new linear closure surface.

criteria.original_criterion: No generic `Monad/do` abstraction can hide `Unitary` / `Iso` / `Observe` boundaries.
criteria.checked_contract: No general quantum Monad/do route; actual #81/#82 retirement diagnostics and principal effect assertions retain all three effects.
criteria.limits: Checked scoped compiler bodies are not outlawed or silently reclassified.

criteria.original_criterion: Future host I/O remains outside the current three-effect quantum core.
criteria.checked_contract: Host I/O is outside accepted source quantum effects; current primitives/AST admit no arbitrary host-I/O effect.
criteria.limits: Host CLI/Python orchestration is separate; identifiers have no magic IO semantics.

criteria.original_criterion: qlippy/docs can diagnose or explain at least the major Haskell semantic false friends.
criteria.checked_contract: Reference explains the major false friends; actual arity/local-provider text/JSON plus #81/#82 migration/effect diagnostics are checked.
criteria.limits: External qargo/qlippy diagnostic integration is omitted by explicit human authorization; no upgraded-consumer claim.

criteria.original_criterion: Any surface sugar introduced under this umbrella lowers to finite explicit structure that the independent verifier checks.
criteria.checked_contract: No new sugar in this boundary unit. Existing current constructors/coherent maps retain explicit finite lowering, source binding, native artifact checks and fail-closed unsupported projections.
criteria.limits: Valid outputIR is not a universal source-preservation theorem; QS/PR/RS/EXACT and two admitted guarantees retain exact scopes/statuses.

scope: Original14boundary criteria remain unchanged. The map is an ordinary technical evidence index, not a human Guardian act, feature-child completion, proof discharge or release approval. Performed command records and exact review/input identities are linked by a separate final validation manifest. QFT excluded; no new maximum cases.
